title: The Beaumont Children Disappearance
hook: Three siblings vanished from a beach, and no trace remains.
headline: The beach where children disappeared

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: On a sunny January day, Jane, Arnny and Grant Beaumont walked to Glenelg Beach.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Witnesses saw the children around 12:15 near Glenelg Beach; they were not seen after that.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Police found a single shoe imprint and a torn dress hem near dunes.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: A 2018 witness said an orange van lingered on the beach that night.

end.line: What really happened on that silent summer evening?

description: Explore the baffling disappearance of the Beaumont children at Glenelg Beach.

facts.claim: Jane, Arnny and Grant Beaumont disappeared on 26 January 1966 from Glenelg Beach.
Witnesses said the children vanished near the rock pools around 5 pm.
Police found a single shoe imprint and a torn piece of a dress during the search.
In 2018 a new witness reported an orange van parked near the beach that night.
